long_biography.plain_text:
Painting has accompanied healthcare entrepreneur Eric Souêtre since his medical-student days. He took drawing and painting classes alongside medicine in Bordeaux, later studying at Saint Martins in London. His visual work combines photography with oil paint, using altered images and a restrained palette to explore ruins and collective memory. He has exhibited at London's Lethaby Gallery.

Souêtre specialised in psychiatry and undertook clinical research at the National Institutes of Health in the United States. His writing includes Manuel de la pratique médicale en mer, a handbook on first aid and medical emergencies at sea, published in 1986.

confidence.reason: The directly read personal biography establishes art and medical formation and the named gallery; the artist's explanation establishes technique and subject.
